title: Trader servant paper book is retried as a trading persona and its pool publish refusals grow without a cap
root_cause_classes: RC3 WP3.1 (unbounded refusal growth in bff.persona_pool_publish_records and persona.strategy_pools)
RC4 Agora servant paper book (SD-AGORA-SERVANT-CORE-CAPABILITIES-20261127 T7 follow-through)

incident_summary.observed_symptom: After PAPER-TRADER-BOOK-PROVISION-20261127 provisioned the trader servant paper book at 2026-11-27 09:42Z, _reconcile_paper_enrollment_once in services/control-plane/bff/personas/service.py picked up trader-paper-book:tenant-default:agora-servant-799a3ce8c021b91cbb54 every 600 s as a trading persona and attempted to seed and publish a strategy pool, appending 16 'no strategy pool for persona agora-servant-799a3ce8c021b91cbb54' refusals in 2.6 hours (~144/day) into bff.persona_pool_publish_records without deduplication or cap.

code_changes: services/control-plane/bff/personas/service.py: added _is_non_trading_paper_enrollment_record(record, persona_owner=...) and guarded _is_paper_enrollment_record_actionable and _reconcile_paper_enrollment_once so trader servant paper book and non-trading persona records are never acted on.

services/control-plane/bff/persona_provisioning_coordinator.py: added _is_non_trading_paper_enrollment_record(record) and guarded _enroll_in_place and reconcile_paper_enrollment so direct coordinator enrollment calls also skip trader servant paper book and non-trading persona records without acquiring a lease or invoking PersonaPaperEnrollment.

services/control-plane/bff/personas/trader_paper_book.py: included persona_class='agora_servant' and book_kind='trader_servant_paper_book' in trader_paper_book_provisioning_record request_payload while keeping request_hash unchanged.
ac1_enrollment_skip.rule_reuse: Delegates non-trading persona classification to services/control-plane/bff/personas/fleet_classification.py::is_non_trading_persona (persona_class == 'agora_servant' / advisory purpose) and checks book_kind == 'trader_servant_paper_book' (plus trader-paper-book: idempotency_key / user_private_agora_servant_paper_book mandate for the already-persisted 09:42Z hosted record) with no second list of non-trading persona classes.

bff_persona_pool_publish_records.reads_fields: Returns publisher.history(tenant_id, persona_id) containing published, refusals, current_envelope
Reads only history['published']; does not read history['refusals']

persona_strategy_pools.reads_fields: Iterates versions.get('refusals') or [] and attaches each refusal dict to similar_history entries

bounding_contract.deduplication_rule: When the newest entry in refusals has the same step and reason (and artifact_ref in persona.strategy_pools), count is incremented in place and last_at is updated to the current timestamp instead of appending a new row.
bounding_contract.kept_envelope_compaction: PersonaPoolPublisher._refuse stores only {'version': <envelope_version>, 'digest': <pool_or_envelope_digest>} in previous_envelope_kept (or null when no envelope is running), never a full envelope copy, and normalizes every retained legacy refusal entry's previous_envelope_kept to its own historical {'version', 'digest'} within the same _refuse CAS mutation (preserving historical identity whether a distinct reason appends or a repeated same-reason retry updates the newest entry in place).
bounding_contract.cleanup_and_rollout_budget: Compaction and the 20-entry cap execute in place inside the refusal CAS write path (PersonaPoolPublisher._refuse and PersonaStrategyPoolStore._record_refusal) while leaving publish(), _load(), and history() untouched so this change composes cleanly with POOL-PUBLICATION-CONFIRM-DISPATCHED-ENVELOPE-20261127 and adds 0 read-path writers or background jobs. On rollout: (1) any record that receives a subsequent refusal immediately trims refusals to <=20 entries and normalizes all retained legacy previous_envelope_kept entries in place to <=10 KB total (~0.3-0.5 KB/entry); (2) the hosted servant record tenant-default:agora-servant-799a3ce8c021b91cbb54 accumulated pre-deploy refusals at step='pool' with current_envelope=null / previous_envelope_kept=null (~180 B/entry, <4 KB total inside the 65,536-byte bff.persona_pool_publish_records table) and stops receiving refusals once AC1 deploys (0/day); (3) quiescent records that never hit a refusal write again retain their existing persisted rows until their next refusal CAS mutation (or an explicit operator maintenance trim if a quiescent pre-existing record ever exceeded 20 entries).
bounding_contract.scope_isolation: In services/control-plane/bff/persona_pool_publisher.py, only _refuse (and _envelope_summary / _kept_envelope_summary / _normalize_refusal_entry / MAX_REFUSALS) was modified; publish(), _load(), history(), published[*].status, and current_envelope are untouched to compose cleanly with POOL-PUBLICATION-CONFIRM-DISPATCHED-ENVELOPE-20261127.

code_references.role: Enqueues confirmed trader paper intents onto the servant's paper RuntimeBinding queue via DecisionSignalProducer.produce with metadata.capital_pool_id = plan['capital_pool_id'].
Instantiates PaperExecutionAlgorithm with risk_policy=None and risk_policy_id=None, drains signals from the binding queue, and evaluates every paper order through EvaluateOrderRiskGate.

Calls resolve_bound_pool_risk_policy(capital_pool_id=self._capital_pool_id, ...); if no active RiskPolicy with an approved profile mapping is bound on the CapitalPool, raises RiskPolicyError and rejects the paper order with reason='risk_policy_unavailable'.

Resolves CapitalPool.metadata.risk_policy and verifies CapitalPool.metadata.profile_mapping_approval_id against Governance target_type='capital_pool_activation' decisions; fails closed with risk_policy_missing (lines 3830-3835) or risk_policy_profile_mapping_unapproved (lines 4499-4560) when absent.
Runtime-Manager authority verification also checks pool risk policy bindings via resolve_pool_risk_policy_binding.

ensure_trader_paper_book_integration.mechanism: When Capital and Governance are configured on the coordinator transport (_transport_supports_paper_risk_gate), ensure_trader_paper_book first performs a GET-first check via resolve_pool_risk_policy_binding (0 POST/PATCH calls when already resolved). When not yet resolved, it calls coordinator.repair_paper_pool_risk_policy (Pass 1 drafts the policy via the risk-officer drafter with no hardcoded limits, proposes capital_pool_activation to Governance, and decides it via the P-4 automated paper risk gate with actor_role='automated_gate' and no human approval; Pass 2 discovers the gate-approved decision and binds metadata.risk_policy and metadata.profile_mapping_approval_id onto the servant's CapitalPool).

checks: Over 30 minutes after dev deploy switch, 0 new refusals are appended for agora-servant-799a3ce8c021b91cbb54 in bff.persona_pool_publish_records (GET /bff/personas/agora-servant-799a3ce8c021b91cbb54/strategy-pool/publish-history).
Coordinator 70b5f70f records the hosted observation outcome.

ac6_runtime_budget.servant_refusal_cadence_before: ~144 refusals/day (1 refusal every 600 s per trader servant paper book record)
ac6_runtime_budget.servant_refusal_cadence_after: 0 refusals/day (trader servant paper book records are skipped before pool enrollment/publish)
ac6_runtime_budget.publish_record_refusal_cap: At most 20 refusal entries per persona record in bff.persona_pool_publish_records and persona.strategy_pools; consecutive identical (step, reason) refusals increment count and update last_at in place
ac6_runtime_budget.refusal_entry_size_bytes: ~300-500 bytes (0.3-0.5 KB) per entry with compact previous_envelope_kept={'version', 'digest'}; <=10 KB total refusals payload per persona record after refusal-write compaction (every retained legacy previous_envelope_kept in the record is normalized to its own historical {'version', 'digest'} during the _refuse CAS mutation; quiescent records that never hit a refusal write again retain their existing persisted rows without read-path mutation, while the hosted servant record had previous_envelope_kept=null inside the 65,536-byte bff.persona_pool_publish_records table and stops growing at 0 refusals/day after deploy)
